text: Unleash my strength. I'm ready to track. Flush them out. What lies before me? My quarry nears.

The beasts obey me. Where I lay my head is home. See that rock? That's my pillow. The beasts around me are nothing compared to the beast within. I will now summon the effete Dwayne-Two! I summon the... Ah! Don't have a cow. Oh, dear. Oops. Please bear with me. Oh, rats!
Unleash the beast! By fang and claw! Mangy cur!
I've got the scent. On the prowl. Our paths converge. I'm acting on instinct. I wander alone.
I hear the call of the wild.

I have wandered alone for many years, little Misha. Yet sometimes even I grow weary of this endless solitude. I have watched the other races. I have seen their squabbling, their ruthlessness. Their wars do nothing but scar the land and drive the wild things to extinction.

No, they cannot be trusted. Only beasts are above deceit. A battle. Hold fast, stranger. You shall not stand alone. Your stomach's been split open. I can do little to ease your pain. Failure. I will deliver your message, old one. For the sake of honor, I will uphold your charge.

May the winds bear you swiftly to your ancestors, warrior. Well, Misha, it seems we'll be seeing civilization after all. Let's get moving. A warrior city. I have not seen its like in many years. Stay close to me, Misha. I carry a message for your war chief. I'll not stay long.
A moment, Warchief. I come to deliver a message. He fell in the wilds. His last wish was that you receive this message. I am Rexxar, last son of the mogu Nath'hal.

Perhaps I have spent too long in the wilds. Your offer is kind, thrall, but I must carry my own weight. Just show me what needs doing, and I'll earn my keep. This must be one of the caravans Nazgrel told me about. I never intended to chase you out. I intend to bury you here.
